sections.name: Trust center entry
sections.description: The trust-center opener: quiet centered header, one search field, and a grid of document cards (security overview, DPA, subprocessor list, pen-test summary) each carrying a mono updated stamp and a download or request button. An illustrative-documents footnote keeps it fictional-safe.

props.name: docs
props.doc: document cards; icon is a glyph key ('doc' | 'lock' | 'shield'), updated renders as a mono stamp, action is the button label

props.name: footnote
props.doc: mono footnote under the grid; empty string hides it

sections.name: Subprocessor register
sections.description: The subprocessor register on the bundle Table: fictional vendors (Northcloud Hosting, Relay Mail, Quarrystone Data…) with purpose, a region chip, and a right-aligned mono reviewed stamp. Header block carries the register-updated stamp and the 30-day change notice.

props.name: registerStamp
props.doc: mono stamp at the header's end, e.g. 'Register updated 2026-07-14'

props.name: footnote
props.doc: mono footnote under the table; empty string hides it

sections.name: Data flow diagram
sections.description: Where your data lives, as a token-built three-node diagram: your stack, the Alfred runtime, your workspace, joined by labeled connectors (read-only in, write-back only on approval) whose arrows flip with the reading direction. Region chips on every node; the runtime node carries the EU or US choice.

props.name: nodes
props.doc: exactly the diagram's nodes, in flow order; chips are mono region pills

props.name: connectors
props.doc: one per gap between nodes; label sits above the arrow, note below

props.name: footnote
props.doc: mono footnote under the diagram; empty string hides it

sections.name: Security commitments grid
sections.description: The security commitments as a quiet grid: no training on your data, logical isolation, SSO and SCIM, audit trail, retention controls, region pinning. Each card pairs a single-color line glyph with a one-sentence promise written as a contract term, not a marketing line.

props.name: items
props.doc: commitment cards; icon is a glyph key ('noTraining' | 'isolation' | 'key' | 'audit' | 'clock' | 'pin')

props.name: footnote
props.doc: mono footnote under the grid; empty string hides it
